defmodule ACN.Agents.TaskManager do
  @moduledoc """
  The TaskManager agent orchestrates the decomposition of high-level tasks into batched sub-tasks.
  In Intermediate Nodes, it uses a single AI bot (tm_planner) to generate a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG)
  represented as sequential batches of parallel tasks.
  """
  use GenServer
  require Logger
  alias ACN.Core.NodeRegistry
  alias ACN.Core.ProfileLoader
  alias ACN.AI.Pipeline
  alias ACN.AI.ContextBuffer
  alias ACN.Router
  alias ACN.Core.Utils.ID
  alias ACN.Observability.Panopticon

  # --- Public API ---

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    node_id = opts[:node_id] || "root"
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: via_tuple(node_id))
  end

  defp via_tuple(node_id) do
    NodeRegistry.via_tuple(:task_manager, "#{node_id}_task_manager")
  end

  # --- Server Callbacks ---

  defmodule State do
    defstruct [
      :phase,
      :router
    ]
  end

  @impl true
  def init(opts) do
    node_id = opts[:node_id] || "root"
    router_state = %Router.State{
      agent_role: :task_manager,
      node_id: node_id,
      local_directory: Router.discover_local_agents(node_id)
    }

    state = %State{
      phase: :idle,
      router: router_state
    }
    {:ok, state}
  end


  # --- Morphic State Handlers ---
  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:wake}, state) do
    Logger.info("TaskManager: Waking up (Morphic State: INTERMEDIATE). Ready to plan.")
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:sleep}, state) do
    Logger.info("TaskManager: Entering Sleep Mode (Morphic State: LEAF).")
    {:noreply, state, :hibernate}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:set_local_identity, _identity}, state) do
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:routed_message, _sender, payload}, state) do
    GenServer.cast(self(), payload)
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  # --- Simplified Single-Bot Planning ---
  
  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:receive_implementation_package, package}, state) do
    Logger.info("TaskManager: Received Implementation Package. Generating Single-Bot Plan...")
    
    # 1. Prepare Variables for Profile
    task_desc = package.task_description
    rules = package.rules || []
    rules_text = (if is_list(rules), do: Enum.join(rules, "\n"), else: rules)
    
    vars = %{
      task_description: task_desc,
      rules: rules_text,
      context: package.full_context,
      deep_context: package.full_context,
      blueprint_spec: package[:blueprint_spec] || package["blueprint_spec"] || "No blueprint available."
    }
    
     # 2. Load Profile
    case ProfileLoader.load("tm_planner", vars) do
      {:ok, profile} ->
        run_planner_with_retry(profile, package, state, 5)
        
      {:error, reason} ->
         Logger.error("TaskManager: Failed to load tm_planner profile: #{inspect(reason)}")
    end
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  defp run_planner_with_retry(profile, package, state, attempts_left) do
    buffer = ContextBuffer.new(profile["system_prompt"])
    adapter = Application.get_env(:acn, :ai)[:default_adapter] || ACN.AI.Adapters.OllamaAdapter
    config = %{adapter: adapter, opts: [model: profile["model"], temperature: profile["temperature"], tool_choice: "ANY"]}
    
    Logger.info("TaskManager: Running Planner (Attempts left: #{attempts_left})...")
    
    case Pipeline.run(buffer, ["submit_plan"], config) do
      {:ok, msg, _, _} ->
          # CRITICAL VALIDATION: Check if bot actually called the tool
          tool_calls = Map.get(msg, :tool_calls) || []
          has_submit_plan_call = Enum.any?(tool_calls, fn tc ->
            get_in(tc, ["function", "name"]) == "submit_plan"
          end)
          
          if !has_submit_plan_call do
             if attempts_left > 1 do
                Logger.warning("TaskManager: Planner did NOT call submit_plan tool. Retrying with feedback...")
                # Inject feedback into task description
                feedback = "\n\n[CRITICAL SYSTEM ERROR]: You FAILED to call the submit_plan tool in your previous attempt. You MUST call the submit_plan tool with the batches array. DO NOT just describe the plan in text - you MUST use the tool!"
                updated_task = (package.task_description || "") <> feedback
                updated_package = Map.put(package, :task_description, updated_task)
                
                # Reconstruct vars for profile reload
                rules = updated_package.rules || []
                rules_text = (if is_list(rules), do: Enum.join(rules, "\n"), else: rules)
                updated_vars = %{
                  task_description: updated_task,
                  rules: rules_text,
                  context: updated_package.full_context,
                  deep_context: updated_package.full_context,
                  blueprint_spec: updated_package[:blueprint_spec] || updated_package["blueprint_spec"] || "No blueprint available."
                }
                
                {:ok, updated_profile} = ProfileLoader.load("tm_planner", updated_vars)
                run_planner_with_retry(updated_profile, updated_package, state, attempts_left - 1)
             else
                Logger.error("TaskManager: Planner did not call submit_plan tool after retries.")
                report_plan_failure("Bot Failed to Call submit_plan Tool (Exhausted Retries)", package, state.router)
             end
          else
             batches = extract_batches(msg)
             
             if batches == [] do
                if attempts_left > 1 do
                   Logger.warning("TaskManager: Planner returned empty plan. Retrying...")
                   run_planner_with_retry(profile, package, state, attempts_left - 1)
                else
                   Logger.error("TaskManager: Planner returned empty plan after retries.")
                   report_plan_failure("Empty Plan / Parsing Error (Exhausted Retries)", package, state.router)
                end
             else
                # 4. Return Plan to Controller IMMEDIATELY
                plan = %{
                  batches: batches,
                  working_path: package.working_path,
                  parent_node_id: package.parent_node_id,
                 # Pass Blueprint back to Controller
                 blueprint_spec: package[:blueprint_spec] || package["blueprint_spec"]
               }

               # HSG: Inject intent into the Panopticon right before delivering the plan
               Enum.with_index(batches, fn batch, index ->
                 Panopticon.inject_intent(package.parent_node_id, index, batch)
               end)

               Logger.info("TaskManager: Plan Generated (#{length(batches)} batches). Sending to Controller.")
               Router.route({:plan_ready, plan}, {:local, :controller}, state.router)
             end
          end

      error ->
         if attempts_left > 1 do
            Logger.warning("TaskManager: Planner AI Failed. Retrying... Error: #{inspect(error)}")
            run_planner_with_retry(profile, package, state, attempts_left - 1)
         else
            Logger.error("TaskManager: Planner AI Failed after retries: #{inspect(error)}")
            report_plan_failure("AI Pipeline Error: #{inspect(error)}", package, state.router)
         end
    end
  end
        


  defp extract_batches(msg) do
     # 1. Try Tool Call (Primary Protocol)
     tool_call_result = 
       case Map.get(msg, :tool_calls) do
         [tr | _] -> 
           case tr do
             %{"function" => %{"name" => "submit_plan", "arguments" => args_json}} ->
                # REPAIR: Fix common model typo where array is closed with '}' followed by '['
                # e.g., [... }, [ ...
                fixed_json = String.replace(args_json, ~r/}\s*,\s*\[/, "], [")
                case Jason.decode(fixed_json) do
                  {:ok, %{"batches" => b}} when is_list(b) -> 
                    if validate_task_paths(b), do: {:ok, normalize_ids(b)}, else: :error
                  {:ok, list} when is_list(list) -> 
                    if validate_task_paths(list), do: {:ok, normalize_ids(list)}, else: :error
                  _ -> :error
                end
             _ -> :error
           end
         _ -> :error
       end

     case tool_call_result do
       {:ok, batches} -> batches
       :error ->
          # 2. Fallback: Parse raw content
          clean_content = 
            msg.content
            |> to_string()
            |> String.replace(~r/^```json\s*/, "") 
            |> String.replace(~r/\s*```$/, "")
            |> String.trim()
            # REPAIR here too
            |> String.replace(~r/}\s*,\s*\[/, "], [")

          case Jason.decode(clean_content) do
            {:ok, %{"batches" => b}} when is_list(b) -> 
              if validate_task_paths(b), do: normalize_ids(b), else: []
            {:ok, list} when is_list(list) -> 
              if validate_task_paths(list), do: normalize_ids(list), else: []
            _ -> 
               Logger.warning("TaskManager: Failed to parse plan from both Tool and Content.")
               Logger.debug("Raw Content: #{String.slice(msg.content || "", 0, 500)}")
               []
          end
     end
  end

  defp validate_task_paths(batches) when is_list(batches) do
    Enum.all?(batches, fn
      batch when is_list(batch) -> Enum.all?(batch, &has_valid_path?/1)
      task when is_map(task) -> has_valid_path?(task)
      _ -> false 
    end)
  end

  defp has_valid_path?(task) do
    path = task["path"] || task[:path]
    # Ensure path is a string and looks like an absolute path (starts with / or ~)
    is_binary(path) && String.length(path) > 1 && (String.starts_with?(path, "/") or String.starts_with?(path, "~"))
  end

  defp report_plan_failure(reason, _package, router) do
      # Notify Controller of failure so it doesn't hang
      Router.route({:plan_failure, reason}, {:local, :controller}, router)
  end

  defp normalize_ids(batches) when is_list(batches) do
    Enum.map(batches, fn
      batch when is_list(batch) -> Enum.map(batch, &normalize_task_id/1)
      task when is_map(task) -> normalize_task_id(task)
      other -> other
    end)
  end

  defp normalize_task_id(task) when is_map(task) do
    id = task[:id] || task["id"]
    if id do
      Map.put(task, :id, ID.normalize(id))
    else
      task
    end
  end
end

defmodule ACN.Agents.ContextFetcher do
  use GenServer
  require Logger
  alias ACN.Infrastructure.Lattice.{RPC, DeepContext}
  alias ACN.Infrastructure.MemoryClient

  defmodule State do
    defstruct [:supervisor_pid, :task_desc, :path, :lineage]
  end

  # --- Public API ---

  def start_link(args) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, args)
  end

  def hydrate(pid, task_desc, path, lineage, spec_data \\ %{}) do
    GenServer.cast(pid, {:hydrate, task_desc, path, lineage, spec_data})
  end

  # --- Server Callbacks ---

  @impl true
  def init(args) do
    # args should include supervisor_pid
    {:ok, %State{supervisor_pid: args[:supervisor_pid]}}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:hydrate, task_desc, path, lineage, spec_data}, state) do
    Logger.info("ContextFetcher Agent: Starting Parallel Pillar Hydration...")
    
    # CRITICAL VALIDATION: Check path before expensive hydration
    is_path_valid = is_binary(path) && String.length(path) > 0 && 
                    path != "root" && 
                    (String.starts_with?(path, "/") || String.starts_with?(path, "~"))
    
    if !is_path_valid do
       Logger.error("ContextFetcher: Invalid path detected: #{inspect(path)}. Path must be absolute and not 'root'.")
       # Send error back to supervisor to trigger retry
       GenServer.cast(state.supervisor_pid, {:hydration_failed, :invalid_path, path})
       {:noreply, state}
    else
      # 1. Start Parallel Fetch Threads
      task_rules = Task.async(fn -> fetch_rules(lineage) end)
      task_worksheets = Task.async(fn -> fetch_worksheets(lineage) end)
      task_blueprint = Task.async(fn -> fetch_blueprint(lineage.parent) end)
      task_acms = Task.async(fn -> fetch_acms(task_desc) end)

      # 2. Await Results
      rules_result = Task.await(task_rules, 30_000)
      worksheets_result = Task.await(task_worksheets, 30_000)
      blueprint_result = Task.await(task_blueprint, 30_000)
      acms_result = Task.await(task_acms, 300_000) # Increased for Rate Limiting queue

      # 3. Assemble DeepContext
      deep_context = %DeepContext{
        blueprint: blueprint_result,
        rules: rules_result,
        worksheets: worksheets_result,
        acms_results: acms_result,
        task: task_desc,
        path: path,
        parent_node_id: lineage[:parent_id] || "root",
        # SPECIFICATION FIDELITY: Include specification fields
        original_specification: spec_data[:original_specification],
        specification_depth: spec_data[:specification_depth],
        specification_metadata: spec_data[:specification_metadata]
      }

      Logger.info("ContextFetcher Agent: Hydration Complete. Notifying Supervisor.")
      
      # 4. Notify Supervisor
      GenServer.cast(state.supervisor_pid, {:hydration_ready, deep_context})

      {:noreply, state}
    end
  end

  # --- Private Helpers (Pillar Logic) ---

  defp fetch_rules(lineage) do
    p_rules = if lineage.parent, do: rpc_call(lineage.parent, :get_rules, []), else: []
    gp_rules = if lineage.grandparent, do: rpc_call(lineage.grandparent, :get_rules, []), else: []
    ggp_rules = if lineage.great_grandparent, do: rpc_call(lineage.great_grandparent, :get_rules, []), else: []
    
    %DeepContext.Rules{
      master: ACN.Core.Governance.MasterRules.get_rules(),
      ancestral: List.wrap(p_rules) ++ List.wrap(gp_rules) ++ List.wrap(ggp_rules),
      local: []
    }
  end

  defp fetch_worksheets(lineage) do
    %{
      parent: if(lineage.parent, do: rpc_call(lineage.parent, :get_worksheet, %{}), else: %{}),
      grandparent: if(lineage.grandparent, do: rpc_call(lineage.grandparent, :get_worksheet, %{}), else: %{}),
      great_grandparent: if(lineage.great_grandparent, do: rpc_call(lineage.great_grandparent, :get_worksheet, %{}), else: %{})
    }
  end

  defp fetch_blueprint(nil), do: "No ancestral blueprint available (Root)."
  defp fetch_blueprint(parent_pid) do
    rpc_call(parent_pid, :get_blueprint, "No blueprint obtained from parent.")
  end

  defp fetch_acms(query) do
    case MemoryClient.query(query, 5) do
      {:ok, results} -> results
      _ -> []
    end
  end

  defp rpc_call(pid, call, default) do
    case RPC.fast_call(pid, call, 5000) do
      {:ok, {:ok, result}} -> result
      {:ok, result} -> result
      _ -> 
        Logger.warning("ContextFetcher Agent: RPC call #{call} failed for #{inspect pid}")
        default
    end
  end
end

defmodule ACN.Agents.SupervisorAgent do
  use GenServer
  require Logger
  alias ACN.Core.NodeRegistry
  alias ACN.Router

  alias ACN.Infrastructure.Lattice.{Lineage, DeepContext}
  alias ACN.Agents.ContextFetcher
  alias ACN.Core.ProfileLoader
  alias ACN.Core.Worksheet
  alias ACN.AI.Pipeline
  alias ACN.AI.ContextBuffer
  alias ACN.Core.Security.TokenAuthority
  alias ACN.Core.Utils.ID
  alias ACN.Observability.TraceContext

  defmodule State do
    defstruct [:args, :identity, :current_profile, :worksheet, :router, :parent_supervisor_pid,
               :private_key, :public_key, :lineage, :context_fetcher_pid, :local_blueprint, :is_root,
               context: %{}, children: %{}, hydration_retry_count: 0, initialized: false,
               # Issue 1 fix: deferred shutdown until all child PIDs have exited
               shutdown_pending: false]
  end

  # --- Public API ---

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    node_id =
      case opts do
        map when is_map(map) -> map[:node_id] || map[:task] || map["node_id"] || map["task"]
        list when is_list(list) -> Keyword.get(list, :node_id) || Keyword.get(list, :task)
        _ -> nil
      end

    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: via_tuple(node_id))
  end

  def get_public_context do
    # Returns the CURRENT, REAL-TIME state of this node.
    # Called by children during JIT Genesis.
    # We target the named supervisor (Genesis) if no ID passed, assuming Parent is Main.
    GenServer.call(via_tuple(nil), :get_current_state_payload)
  end

  defp via_tuple(id) do
    target_id = id || "root"
    NodeRegistry.via_tuple(:supervisor, target_id)
  end

  # --- Server Callbacks ---

  @impl true
  def init(opts) do
    Process.flag(:trap_exit, true)

    node_id = 
       case opts do
         map when is_map(map) -> map[:node_id] || map[:task] || "root"
         list when is_list(list) -> Keyword.get(list, :node_id) || Keyword.get(list, :task) || "root"
         _ -> "root"
       end

    # Load Genesis Profile
    init_vars = %{
       task: "ACN Genesis (#{node_id})",
       deep_context: %DeepContext{
         path: nil,
         worksheets: %{parent: nil, grandparent: nil, great_grandparent: nil},
         acms_results: [],
         rules: %DeepContext.Rules{master: ACN.Core.Governance.MasterRules.get_rules(), ancestral: [], local: []},
         blueprint: nil,
         task: "ACN Genesis (#{node_id})"
       }
    }

    profile =
      case ProfileLoader.load("supervisor_identity", init_vars) do
        {:ok, p} -> p
        {:error, reason} -> raise "CRITICAL: Genesis Profile Missing! Reason: #{inspect(reason)}"
      end

    # 1. Start Enclave Supervisor (Isolated Sibling Tree)
    # IDEMPOTENT: Handle cases where the enclave might already be running (e.g. node reload/crash)
    _enclave_pid = 
      case start_enclave_supervisor(node_id) do
        {:ok, pid} -> pid
        {:error, {:already_started, pid}} -> pid
        _ -> nil
      end

    # 2. Initialize Router
    router_state = %Router.State{
      agent_role: :supervisor,
      node_id: node_id,
      local_directory: Router.discover_local_agents(node_id)
    }

    # Keymaster: Generate Ephemeral Keys for this Node
    {priv, pub} = TokenAuthority.generate_keypair()

    # 2024-01-29 Fix: Self-Kickstart. Ensure init_node runs immediately.
    # We pass opts as args. If pushed_lineage is present, it will be used.
    # CRITICAL FIX: Convert opts to MAP to prevent Access errors with string keys later.
    GenServer.cast(self(), {:init_node, Map.new(opts)})

    {:ok, %State{current_profile: profile, worksheet: Worksheet.new(), router: router_state, private_key: priv, public_key: pub, lineage: %{parent: nil, grandparent: nil, great_grandparent: nil}, args: %{node_id: node_id}, context: %DeepContext{}, initialized: false}}
  end

  defp start_enclave_supervisor(node_id) do
    Logger.info("SupervisorAgent: Starting Enclave Supervisor for #{node_id}...")
    ACN.Agents.EnclaveSupervisor.start_link(node_id: node_id)
  end

  # --- info ---

  @impl true
  def handle_info({:EXIT, _pid, :normal}, state) do
    # Issue 1 fix: if we are waiting to shut down, check whether all children are gone.
    if state.shutdown_pending do
      live_children = Enum.any?(state.children, fn {_id, %{pid: pid}} -> Process.alive?(pid) end)
      if live_children do
        Logger.info("Supervisor: shutdown_pending — still waiting for live children to exit.")
        {:noreply, state}
      else
        Logger.info("Supervisor: All children exited. Executing deferred shutdown.")
        {:stop, :normal, state}
      end
    else
      {:noreply, state}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info({:EXIT, pid, reason}, state) do
    # Robustness Pillar: Log agent deaths but don't crash
    Logger.error("SupervisorAgent: DETECTED CRITICAL AGENT DEATH (#PID#{inspect pid}). Reason: #{inspect reason}")
    # EnclaveSupervisor should handle the actual restart. 
    # This handler just prevents SupervisorAgent from crashing due to linked death.
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info({:init_node, args}, state) do
    Logger.info("SupervisorAgent: Bootstrapping Node Identity...")
    GenServer.cast(self(), {:fetch_context, args})
    {:noreply, %{state | args: args}}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info({:retry_init, new_args}, state) do
     Logger.info("SupervisorAgent: Retrying init_node with updated args...")
     GenServer.cast(self(), {:init_node, new_args})
     {:noreply, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info(msg, state) do
    Logger.warning("SupervisorAgent: Received UNHANDLED INFO: #{inspect(msg)}")
    {:noreply, state}
  end
  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:spawn_child, child_spec}, state) do
    # Log lineage for complete trace visibility
    ACN.Observability.AuditLogger.log_lineage(state.node_id, child_spec.id, child_spec.task)
    
    # 2024-01-29 PUSH PROTOCOL: Inject Lineage directly into child args.
    # This ensures the child doesn't need to perform a risky RPC handshake.
    pushed_lineage = %{
      parent: self(),
      grandparent: state.lineage.parent,
      great_grandparent: state.lineage.grandparent
    }
    
    enriched_spec = Map.put(child_spec, :pushed_lineage, pushed_lineage)

    ACN.Core.NodeSupervisor.start_child_node(enriched_spec)
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:routed_message, _sender, payload}, state) do
    GenServer.cast(self(), payload)
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:init_node, _args}, %{initialized: true} = state) do
    Logger.debug("SupervisorAgent: init_node called but already initialized. Ignoring. (Idempotency Guard)")
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:init_node, args}, state) do
    # 1. Store Genesis Args
    state = %{state | args: args, parent_supervisor_pid: args[:parent_supervisor_pid], initialized: true}
    task_id = ID.normalize(args[:task] || args["task"] || "root")
    Logger.info("Supervisor Initializing Node: #{task_id}")

    # HSG: Begin trace context for this entire node process.
    # The materialized path is derived from the parent's node_id so all children
    # inherit a globally unique, rooted causal path (e.g. "root.auth.db").
    parent_node_id = args[:parent_node] || args["parent_node"]
    parent_mat_path =
      if parent_node_id && parent_node_id != "root" && parent_node_id != :root,
        do: to_string(parent_node_id),
        else: nil
    TraceContext.begin_trace(task_id, parent_mat_path)

    # RACE REDUCTION: If this task ID looks like a parallel batch child, add a tiny jitter
    # This prevents multiple nodes from hitting the same directory mkdir/stat calls simultaneously.
    if String.contains?(task_id, "_") do
       Process.sleep(:rand.uniform(100))
    end

    # 2. DEEP GENESIS: Ancestral Resolution & Context Aggregation
    parent_id = args[:parent_node] || args[:parent]
    is_root = is_nil(parent_id) or parent_id == :nonode@nohost
    
    task_desc = args[:task_description] || args["task_description"] || args[:task_desc_minimal] || "Unknown Task"
    
    # Resolve Path: Ensure it is absolute
    raw_path_arg = args[:path] || args[:output_directive] || args["path"] || args["output_directive"]
    
    # EXTRACT PATH FROM PROMPT if argument is missing
    raw_path = 
       if is_nil(raw_path_arg) or raw_path_arg == "root" do
          case Regex.run(~r/(?:in|at|path|directory|workspace)\s+([\/~][\w\-\.\/]+)/i, task_desc) do
             [_, extracted_path] -> extracted_path
             _ -> "root"
          end
       else
          raw_path_arg
       end

    path = 
      if raw_path == "root" do
        ACN.Infrastructure.Workspace.root_path() || File.cwd!()
      else
        if Path.type(raw_path) == :relative do
          Path.expand(raw_path, ACN.Infrastructure.Workspace.root_path() || File.cwd!())
        else
          raw_path
        end
      end

    Logger.info("Executing Lineage Handshake for Parent: #{inspect state.parent_supervisor_pid}")
    
    # 2024-01-29 PUSH PROTOCOL: Use pushed lineage if available.
    lineage_map = 
      if args[:pushed_lineage] do
        Logger.info("Lineage Info PUSHED from Parent. Skipping Handshake RPC.")
        args[:pushed_lineage]
      else
        # Fallback for Root or Legacy calls
        Lineage.handshake(state.parent_supervisor_pid)
      end

    # 3. Start ContextFetcher Agent
    {:ok, cf_pid} = ContextFetcher.start_link(supervisor_pid: self())
    
    Logger.info("Triggering Asynchronous Context Hydration (Pillars I-IV)...")
    
    # Prepare specification data for ContextFetcher
    spec_data = %{
      original_specification: args[:original_specification] || args["original_specification"],
      specification_depth: args[:specification_depth] || args["specification_depth"],
      specification_metadata: args[:specification_metadata] || args["specification_metadata"]
    }
    
    ContextFetcher.hydrate(cf_pid, task_desc, path, lineage_map, spec_data)

    # 4. Extract Specification Fields (for Specification Fidelity)
    original_spec = args[:original_specification] || args["original_specification"]
    current_depth = args[:specification_depth] || args["specification_depth"] || (if is_root, do: 0, else: 2)
    
    spec_metadata = args[:specification_metadata] || args["specification_metadata"] || %{
      version: "1.0",
      ingested_at: DateTime.utc_now(),
      source: "user_provided"
    }
    
    # Store specification fields in args for propagation
    updated_args = Map.merge(args, %{
      path: path,
      original_specification: original_spec,
      specification_depth: current_depth,
      specification_metadata: spec_metadata
    })
    
    # 5. Subscribe to Control Topic
    Phoenix.PubSub.subscribe(ACN.PubSub, "acn:control:#{task_id}")

    {:noreply, %{state | is_root: is_root, lineage: lineage_map, context_fetcher_pid: cf_pid, args: Map.merge(state.args, updated_args)}}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:hydration_failed, :invalid_path, path}, state) do
    Logger.error("SupervisorAgent: Context Fetcher reported invalid path: #{inspect(path)}. Triggering retry...")
    
    if state.hydration_retry_count < 5 do
       # Retry path resolution with feedback
       new_args = Map.update(state.args, :task_description, "", fn desc -> 
         "[CRITICAL: Previous path '#{inspect(path)}' was invalid. Ensure absolute path with proper format] " <> desc 
       end)
       
       # Update path to try extraction again
       new_args = Map.put(new_args, :path, nil)
       
       Process.send_after(self(), {:retry_init, new_args}, 1000)
       {:noreply, %{state | hydration_retry_count: state.hydration_retry_count + 1}}
    else
       Logger.error("SupervisorAgent: Path validation FAILED after retries from ContextFetcher.")
       Process.exit(self(), :invalid_path_fatal)
       {:noreply, state}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:hydration_ready, deep_context}, state) do
    # STRICTOR PATH ENFORCEMENT (High Priority)
    path = deep_context.path
    is_root = state.is_root
    workspace_root = Application.get_env(:acn, :workspace_root)
    
    is_path_valid = 
      if is_root do
        # Root node can be at the workspace root
        is_binary(path) && String.length(path) > 0
      else
        # Child nodes MUST have a sub-path (not root) and it must be absolute
        is_binary(path) && path != "root" && path != workspace_root && (String.starts_with?(path, "/") or String.starts_with?(path, "~"))
      end

    if !is_path_valid && state.hydration_retry_count < 5 do
       Logger.error("SupervisorAgent: Target Path Missing or Invalid for Child Node (Path: #{inspect(path)}). Retrying Context Gathering...")
       # Feedback: Pre-pend error to task description to nudge next attempt's path extraction
       new_args = Map.update(state.args, :task_description, "", fn desc -> "[RETRY NUDGE: Previous path resolution failed. Ensure path is absolute] " <> desc end)
       
       Process.send_after(self(), {:init_node, new_args}, 1000)
       {:noreply, %{state | hydration_retry_count: state.hydration_retry_count + 1}}
    else
      if !is_path_valid do
         Logger.error("SupervisorAgent: Target Path Enforcement FAILED after retries. System integrity at risk.")
         # Shutdown node to prevent zombie work without path
         System.stop(1) # Or some other more localized failure? 
         # Actually, just stop this supervisor.
         Process.exit(self(), :kill)
         {:noreply, state}
      else
        Logger.info("Context Hydration Complete. Path Verified: #{path}. Proceeding to Identity Determination.")
        
        task_desc = state.args[:task_description] || state.args["task_description"] || state.args[:task_desc_minimal] || "Unknown Task"

    # Determine Identity via AI (Using Full Hydrated Context)
    vars = %{
      task: task_desc,
      deep_context: deep_context
    }
    
      case ProfileLoader.load("supervisor_identity", vars) do
        {:ok, profile} ->
          Logger.info("Running Identity Determination Profile...")
          buffer = ContextBuffer.new(profile["system_prompt"])
          adapter = Application.get_env(:acn, :ai)[:default_adapter] || ACN.AI.Adapters.OllamaAdapter
          config = %{
            adapter: adapter, 
            stop_after_tools: true,
            opts: [model: profile["model"], temperature: profile["temperature"], tool_choice: "ANY"]
          }
          
          case Pipeline.run(buffer, ["set_node_identity"], config) do
            {:ok, msg, _final_buffer, _env} ->
              if msg.content && String.contains?(msg.content, "Error executing tool") do
                Logger.error("Identity determination failed silently (Tool Error).")
                GenServer.cast(self(), {:set_identity, "LEAF", state.args[:path]})
                {:noreply, %{state | context: deep_context}}
              else
                {:noreply, %{state | context: deep_context}}
              end

            error ->
              Logger.error("Identity Pipeline failed: #{inspect(error)}")
              GenServer.cast(self(), {:set_identity, "LEAF", state.args[:path]})
              {:noreply, %{state | context: deep_context}}
          end

      {:error, reason} ->
          Logger.error("Failed to load identity profile: #{inspect(reason)}")
          GenServer.cast(self(), {:set_identity, "LEAF", state.args[:path]})
          {:noreply, %{state | context: deep_context}}
    end
       end
     end
  end




  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:set_identity, identity, path}, state) do
    Logger.info("🎯 Identity Confirmed: #{inspect(identity)} | Path: #{inspect(path)}")
    
    # If path is provided, update args and context
    state = 
      if path do
        abs_path = 
          if Path.type(path) == :relative do
            Path.expand(path, Application.get_env(:acn, :workspace_root) || File.cwd!())
          else
            path
          end
          
        new_args = Map.put(state.args, :path, abs_path)
        new_context = %{state.context | path: abs_path}
        %{state | args: new_args, context: new_context}
      else
        state
      end
    
    # 1. Propagate identity to local agents
    local_agents = Router.discover_local_agents(state.args[:node_id])
    state = put_in(state.router.local_directory, local_agents)

    Enum.each(local_agents, fn {role, pid} -> 
      if role == :controller do
        GenServer.cast(pid, {:set_node_identity, identity, state.args[:path], state.is_root})
      else
        GenServer.cast(pid, {:set_local_identity, identity}) 
      end
    end)

    state = %{state | identity: identity}
    
    # 2. Apply Morphic State
    state = apply_morphic_state(identity, state)

    # 3. Handoff
    Logger.info("Context ready. Proceeding to Legislative Handoff.")
    GenServer.cast(self(), {:handoff})

    {:noreply, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:set_local_identity, _identity}, state) do
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  end

    {:noreply, %{state | context: new_context}}
  end

  @impl true

  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:handoff}, state) do
    ctx_map = 
      case state.context do
        %DeepContext{} = dc -> Map.from_struct(dc)
        map when is_map(map) -> map
        _ -> %{}
      end

    working_path = 
      state.args[:path] || 
      state.args["path"] || 
      state.args[:output_directive] || 
      state.args["output_directive"] ||
      ctx_map[:path] ||
      ctx_map["path"] ||
      "root"

    parent_node_id = state.args[:parent_node] || state.args["parent_node"] || Node.self()

    security_token = 
      if state.identity == :leaf do
         target_path = state.args[:output_directive] || state.args["output_directive"] || "unknown"
         {:ok, token, _} = TokenAuthority.mint_token(state.private_key, :actuator, target_path)
         token
      else
         nil
      end

    payload = Map.merge(ctx_map, %{
      task_assignment: %{type: state.identity},
      genesis_args: state.args,
      security_token: security_token,
      public_key: state.public_key,
      working_path: working_path,
      parent_node_id: parent_node_id,
      node_worksheet: Worksheet.to_map(state.worksheet),
      blueprint_spec: state.args[:blueprint_spec] || state.args["blueprint_spec"],
      # Propagate specification fields
      original_specification: state.args[:original_specification],
      specification_depth: state.args[:specification_depth],
      specification_metadata: state.args[:specification_metadata]
    })

    {:ok, updated_router} = Router.route({:initialize_governance, payload}, {:local, :controller}, state.router)
    Logger.info("Handoff Complete. Data & Keys sent to Controller. Working Path: #{working_path}")
    
    node_id = state.args[:task] || state.args["task"] || "root"
    Phoenix.PubSub.broadcast(ACN.PubSub, "acn:monitor:global", {:node_startup, node_id})

    {:noreply, %{state | router: updated_router}}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:override, :pause}, state) do

    apply_morphic_state(:halt, state)
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:override, :restart}, state) do
    Logger.warning("Supervisor: OVERRIDE RESTART RECEIVED. Re-initializing Node...")
    GenServer.cast(self(), {:init_node, state.args})
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:leaf_shutdown_signal, dbc}, state) do
    Logger.info("Supervisor: LF Shutdown Signal received. DBC: #{inspect dbc}")

    child_id = 
      dbc.provenance_data[:node] || 
      dbc.author_id || 
      state.args[:task] ||
      "unknown_child"
    
    updated_children = Map.update(state.children, child_id, 
      %{status: :completed, dbc: dbc},
      fn existing -> %{existing | status: :completed, dbc: dbc} end
    )
    
    total_children = map_size(updated_children)
    completed_count = Enum.count(updated_children, fn {_id, child} -> child.status == :completed end)
    all_complete? = total_children > 0 and completed_count == total_children
    
    parent_id = state.args[:parent_node] || state.args["parent_node"]
    is_root? = is_nil(parent_id) or parent_id == :root or parent_id == "root"
    
    cond do
      is_root? and total_children == 0 ->
        Logger.info("GENESIS COMPLETE: Root Leaf Node execution finished successfully.")
        {:noreply, %{state | identity: :completed, children: updated_children}}
      
      is_root? and all_complete? ->
        Logger.info("GENESIS COMPLETE: All #{total_children} children finished successfully.")
        {:noreply, %{state | identity: :completed, children: updated_children}}
      
      is_root? ->
        {:noreply, %{state | children: updated_children}}
      
      all_complete? and total_children > 0 and state.identity == :leaf ->
        Logger.info("Supervisor: All #{total_children} children completed (Leaf/Independent). Terminating Node #{state.args[:task]}...")
        {:stop, :normal, %{state | children: updated_children}}
      
      total_children > 0 ->
        {:noreply, %{state | children: updated_children}}
      
      true ->
        Logger.warning("Supervisor: Received Leaf Shutdown Signal but conditions for termination not met (Children: #{total_children}, Identity: #{state.identity}). Ignoring.")
        {:noreply, %{state | children: updated_children}}
    end
  end

    {:noreply, state}
  end

  end

  @impl true

    new_state = %{state | local_blueprint: blueprint}
    updated_context = 
      if is_struct(state.context, DeepContext) do
        %{state.context | blueprint: blueprint}
      else
        state.context
      end
    {:noreply, %{new_state | context: updated_context}}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:shutdown_request}, state) do
    # Issue 1 fix: Do NOT stop immediately. The parent must outlive all children.
    # A child that is still bootstrapping (init_node → Lineage.handshake) will
    # crash if the parent exits beneath it. Instead, set shutdown_pending: true
    # and only stop once every tracked child PID has exited naturally.
    live_children = Enum.filter(state.children || %{}, fn {_id, %{pid: pid}} -> Process.alive?(pid) end)

    if live_children == [] do
      Logger.info("Supervisor: No live children remaining. Shutting down now.")
      {:stop, :normal, state}
    else
      Logger.info("Supervisor: shutdown_request received but #{length(live_children)} child(ren) still alive. Deferring stop.")
      {:noreply, %{state | shutdown_pending: true}}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_cast(msg, state) do
    Logger.warning("Supervisor: Received UNHANDLED CAST: #{inspect(msg)}")
    {:noreply, state}
  end


  # --- Calls ---

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:spawn_child, task}, _from, state) do
    task_id = ID.normalize(task["id"] || task[:id] || task["name"] || task[:task] || task["task"] || task["node_id"] || task[:node_id])
    Logger.info("SupervisorAgent: Spawning child for task #{task_id}")
    
    # Use the already-normalized task_id for output_slot to prevent ID mismatch
    output_slot = task_id
    
    Logger.info("SupervisorAgent: Spawning child for task #{task_id}. Task data: #{inspect(task)}")
    child_raw_path = task["path"] || task[:path]
    Logger.info("SupervisorAgent: child_raw_path = #{inspect(child_raw_path)}")
    
    child_path = 
      if is_nil(child_raw_path) do
        parent_path = state.args[:path] || Application.get_env(:acn, :workspace_root) || File.cwd!()
        
        # RECURSION TRAP DETECTION: 
        # If task_id is already a significant segment of parent_path, do not append it.
        # This prevents paths like /.../auth/auth/auth/auth
        path_segments = Path.split(parent_path)
        if task_id in path_segments do
          Logger.warning("SupervisorAgent: Recursion Trap Detected for #{task_id}. Reuse parent path.")
          parent_path
        else
          Path.join(parent_path, to_string(task_id))
        end
      else
        if Path.type(child_raw_path) == :relative do
          Path.expand(child_raw_path, state.args[:path] || File.cwd!())
        else
          child_raw_path
        end
      end

    # Fix 2A: Removed File.mkdir_p!(child_path) — the Intermediate Legislator
    # is the sole owner of directory creation via its mkdir tool call.
    # Pre-creating the directory here caused every intermediate node's workspace
    # to be created twice.


    if is_nil(task_id) do
      Logger.error("SupervisorAgent: CRITICAL - Cannot spawn child with nil task ID!")
      {:reply, {:error, :invalid_task_id}, state}
    else
      child_args = %{
         task: task_id, 
         path: child_path,
         parent_node: state.args[:task] || "root", 
         output_slot: output_slot,
         task_desc_minimal: task["description"] || task[:description],
         ancestral_worksheet: state.worksheet,
         parent_supervisor_pid: self(),
         node_id: task_id,
         blueprint_spec: task[:blueprint_spec] || task["blueprint_spec"]
      }
      
      # SPECIFICATION FIDELITY: Propagate original_specification to ALL depths.
      # Removing the depth <= 3 cliff was a critical fix: deep nodes (depth 4+) were
      # losing the original spec, causing language/framework hallucinations.
      current_depth = state.args[:specification_depth] || 0
      child_depth = if current_depth == 0, do: 2, else: current_depth + 1

      original_spec = state.args[:original_specification]
      spec_metadata = state.args[:specification_metadata]

      Logger.info("SupervisorAgent: Passing full original specification to child at depth #{child_depth}")

      child_args = Map.merge(child_args, %{
        original_specification: original_spec,
        specification_depth: child_depth,
        specification_metadata: spec_metadata
      })

      # Fix 1A: Build and inject pushed_lineage so the child SupervisorAgent can
      # skip the Lineage.handshake() RPC entirely. Without this, every child
      # spawned via handle_call(:spawn_child) fell through to the fallback RPC,
      # which crashed when the parent exited before the child completed the call.
      pushed_lineage = %{
        parent: self(),
        grandparent: state.lineage[:parent],
        great_grandparent: state.lineage[:grandparent]
      }

      child_args = Map.put(child_args, :pushed_lineage, pushed_lineage)

      case ACN.Core.NodeSupervisor.start_child_node(child_args) do
        {:ok, child_pid} ->
           Logger.info("Child Node Spawned: #{inspect(child_pid)}")
           Process.monitor(child_pid)
           GenServer.cast(child_pid, {:init_node, child_args})
           new_children = Map.put(state.children, task_id, %{status: :running, dbc: nil, pid: child_pid})
           {:reply, {:ok, child_pid}, %{state | children: new_children}}

        {:error, {:already_started, child_pid}} ->
           if Process.alive?(child_pid) do
              Logger.info("Child Node #{inspect(task_id)} already active at #{inspect(child_pid)}. Re-initializing (Idempotent).")
              # Also inject pushed_lineage on re-init
              GenServer.cast(child_pid, {:init_node, child_args})
              new_children = Map.put(state.children, task_id, %{status: :running, dbc: nil, pid: child_pid})
              {:reply, {:ok, child_pid}, %{state | children: new_children}}
           else
              Logger.warning("Child Node #{inspect(task_id)} exists in registry but is DEAD (#PID#{inspect child_pid}). Retrying spawn...")
              # Registry cleanup is async, so we wait a bit or try to force it
              # For now, we return error so the Controller can retry or remediate
              {:reply, {:error, :ghost_process_detected}, state}
           end

        {:error, reason} ->
           Logger.error("Failed to spawn child node: #{inspect(reason)}")
           {:reply, {:error, reason}, state}
      end
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call(:get_current_state_payload, _from, state) do
     payload = %{
        rules: state.context[:rules] || [],
        ancestral_memory: Worksheet.to_map(state.worksheet), 
        origin: node(),
        gm_memories: state.context[:gm_memories],
        blueprint_spec: state.args[:blueprint_spec] || state.args["blueprint_spec"]
     }
     {:reply, {:ok, payload}, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call(:get_lineage, _from, state) do
    reply = %{
      parent_pid: self(),
      grandparent_pid: state.lineage[:parent],
      great_grandparent_pid: state.lineage[:grandparent]
    }
    
    # NEW: Race Condition Fix. The child has now successfully completed its initialization
    # handshake. We notify the Controller so it knows this child is "ready" and won't
    # prematurely shut down the enclave if the batch finishes too quickly.
    # We must extract the child's identity from the caller if possible, but we don't know it here.
    # Actually, tracking readiness by child ID is better done via a cast from the child's init,
    # or we just rely on the controller not shutting down until artifacts arrive.
    # No, wait. The Controller gets `:task_complete` from Worksheet injection.
    # Let's send a generic `:child_ready` signal.
    Router.route({:child_handshake_complete}, {:local, :controller}, state.router)
    
    {:reply, {:ok, reply}, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call(:get_rules, _from, state) do
    local_rules = get_in(state.context, [Access.key(:rules, %{}), Access.key(:local, [])]) || []
    {:reply, {:ok, local_rules}, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call(:get_worksheet, _from, state) do
    {:reply, {:ok, Worksheet.to_map(state.worksheet)}, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call(:get_blueprint, _from, state) do
    blueprint = state.local_blueprint || (if is_struct(state.context), do: state.context.blueprint, else: nil) || "No blueprint available."
    {:reply, {:ok, blueprint}, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call(:get_parent_id, _from, state) do
    parent_id = state.args[:parent_node]
    {:reply, {:ok, parent_id}, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call(:get_uplink, _from, state) do
    {:reply, {:ok, state.parent_supervisor_pid}, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call(:get_identity, _from, state) do
    identity = state.identity || :leaf
    {:reply, {:ok, identity}, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call(:get_context, _from, state) do
    {:reply, {:ok, state.context}, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call(:get_node_id, _from, state) do
    node_id = state.args[:node_id] || state.args[:task] || state.args["task"] || "root"
    {:reply, node_id, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call(:get_output_slot, _from, state) do
    slot = state.args[:output_slot] || state.args["output_slot"]
    {:reply, {:ok, slot}, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:inject_node_sheet, slot_id, data}, _from, state) do
    Logger.info("SupervisorAgent: Injecting data into NodeSheet slot: #{slot_id}")
    new_worksheet = Worksheet.put(state.worksheet, slot_id, data, :artifact)
    new_state = %{state | worksheet: new_worksheet}
    Router.route({:task_complete, slot_id}, {:local, :controller}, state.router)
    {:reply, :ok, new_state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call(:get_child_results, _from, state) do
    child_dbcs = 
      state.worksheet
      |> Worksheet.to_map()
      |> Enum.filter(fn {_key, slot} ->
        is_map(slot) and Map.has_key?(slot, :artifact_hash) and Map.has_key?(slot, :fact_text)
      end)
      |> Enum.map(fn {_key, dbc} -> dbc end)
    {:reply, {:ok, child_dbcs}, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:read_worksheet, key}, _from, state) do
    case Worksheet.get(state.worksheet, key) do
      nil -> {:reply, {:error, :not_found}, state}
      slot -> {:reply, {:ok, slot}, state}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:receive_child_artifact, slot_id, artifact, child_id}, _from, state) do
    new_state = commit_artifact(slot_id, artifact, child_id, state)
    if new_state == state do
       {:reply, {:error, :unauthorized}, state}
    else
       {:reply, :ok, new_state}
    end
  end

  # --- Private Helpers ---

  defp commit_artifact(slot_id, artifact, child_id, state) do
    slot_id = ID.normalize(slot_id)
    child_id = ID.normalize(child_id)
    Logger.info("Supervisor committing artifact for Slot: #{slot_id} from Child: #{child_id}")

    if slot_id == child_id do
      # Check if this slot already exists (prevents duplicate ingestion)
      existing_slot = Worksheet.get(state.worksheet, slot_id)
      is_new_artifact = is_nil(existing_slot)
      
      new_worksheet = Worksheet.put(state.worksheet, slot_id, artifact, :artifact)
      
      # Persist to disk (path is in args)
      working_path = state.args[:path] || state.args["path"]
      Worksheet.save(new_worksheet, working_path)
      
      # Ingest to ACMS ONLY if this is a new artifact (prevent duplicates from retries)
      if is_new_artifact do
        Task.start(fn ->
          ACN.Infrastructure.MemoryClient.ingest(artifact)
        end)
      else
        Logger.debug("Supervisor: Artifact #{slot_id} already committed. Skipping duplicate ACMS ingestion.")
      end
      
      Router.route({:task_complete, child_id}, {:local, :controller}, state.router)
      %{state | worksheet: new_worksheet}
    else
      Logger.warning("Security Alert: Child #{child_id} tried to write to unauthorized slot #{slot_id}")
      state
    end
  end

  defp apply_morphic_state(identity, state) do
    case identity do
      :leaf ->
        Logger.info("[Morphic] Mode: LEAF. Sleeping TaskManager.")
        case Router.route({:sleep}, {:local, :task_manager}, state.router) do
          {:ok, s1} -> %{state | router: s1}
          _ -> state
        end
        
      :intermediate ->
        Logger.info("[Morphic] Mode: INTERMEDIATE. Waking TaskManager.")
        with {:ok, s1} <- Router.route({:sleep}, {:local, :actuator}, state.router),
             {:ok, s2} <- Router.route({:wake}, {:local, :task_manager}, s1) do
          %{state | router: s2}
        else
          {:error, reason} -> 
             Logger.error("[Morphic] CRITICAL: Failed to configure INTERMEDIATE mode. Missing agents? Reason: #{inspect(reason)}")
             raise "Morphic State Failure: Required agent not found for :intermediate mode. (Reason: #{inspect(reason)})"
        end
        
      :halt ->
        Logger.info("[Morphic] Mode: HALT. Sleeping all agents.")
        s1 = 
          case Router.route({:sleep}, {:local, :task_manager}, state.router) do
             {:ok, s} -> s
             _ -> state.router
          end
        s2 = 
          case Router.route({:sleep}, {:local, :controller}, s1) do
             {:ok, s} -> s
             _ -> s1
          end
        %{state | router: s2}
        
      _ ->
        Logger.warning("[Morphic] Unknown Identity.")
        state
    end
  end
end

defmodule ACN.Agents.Actuator.ContractVerifier do
  @moduledoc """
  Phase 3: Artifact Contract Verifier.

  Verifies that a leaf node has produced all the files it was contracted to create
  (as declared in the `file_manifest` from the Blueprint phase).

  Called by the Controller before emitting a success signal, ensuring that nodes
  cannot "complete" without having physically created their committed outputs.
  """

  require Logger

  @doc """
  Verifies that all files in `file_manifest` exist within `working_path`.

  ## Parameters
  - `working_path`: The absolute directory the node was bound to.
  - `file_manifest`: List of relative file paths the node was contracted to produce.

  ## Returns
  - `:ok` — All contracted files are present.
  - `{:error, missing_files}` — One or more files are missing. Returns the list.
  - `:skip` — No manifest was provided; verification is skipped (legacy compatibility).
  """
  @spec verify(String.t(), list(String.t())) :: :ok | {:error, list(String.t())} | :skip
  def verify(_working_path, nil), do: :skip
  def verify(_working_path, []), do: :skip
  def verify(working_path, file_manifest) when is_list(file_manifest) do
    missing =
      file_manifest
      |> Enum.reject(fn relative_path ->
        abs_path = Path.join(working_path, relative_path)
        File.exists?(abs_path)
      end)

    if Enum.empty?(missing) do
      Logger.info("ContractVerifier: All #{length(file_manifest)} contracted files verified in #{working_path}.")
      :ok
    else
      Logger.error("""
      ContractVerifier: CONTRACT VIOLATION in #{working_path}.
      Node declared it would produce #{length(file_manifest)} files but #{length(missing)} are MISSING:
      #{Enum.map_join(missing, "\n", fn f -> "  ✗ #{Path.join(working_path, f)}" end)}
      """)
      {:error, missing}
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Builds a feedback string for the AI agent describing which files are missing.
  Used to inject into a retry prompt so the agent knows exactly what to produce.
  """
  @spec build_feedback(String.t(), list(String.t())) :: String.t()
  def build_feedback(working_path, missing_files) do
    file_list = Enum.map_join(missing_files, "\n", fn f -> "  - #{Path.join(working_path, f)}" end)
    """
    [CONTRACT VIOLATION]: Your task is not complete. The following files were declared in your blueprint \
    but were NOT created:
    #{file_list}

    You MUST create ALL missing files before your task can be considered complete. \
    Use the write_to_file tool for each missing file.
    """
  end
end

defmodule ACN.Agents.Actuator.Sandbox do
  @moduledoc """
  Manages the lifecycle of the Firecracker MicroVM.
  Acts as the "Function-as-a-Service" provider.
  """
  require Logger
  alias ACN.Actuator.RustlerBridge

  @doc """
  Executes a command inside the isolated Sandbox.
  1. Boot VM
  2. Run Command
  3. Teardown
  """
  def run(command, args, opts \\ []) do
    if Application.get_env(:acn, :simulation_mode, false) do
      run_simulation(command, args, opts)
    else
      run_firecracker(command, args, opts)
    end
  end

  defp run_firecracker(command, args, _opts) do
    # 1. Prepare Infrastructure
    uuid = UUID.uuid4()
    socket_path = "/tmp/acn_#{uuid}.socket"
    
    # 2. Spawn Firecracker
    # We must ensure previous socket is gone
    File.rm(socket_path)
    
    port = spawn_firecracker(socket_path)
    Logger.debug("Sandbox: VM #{uuid} spawned on #{socket_path}")

    try do
      # 3. Bridge Call (Blocking)
      # The NIF handles the connect/boot/exec sequence
      case RustlerBridge.run_cmd(socket_path, command, args) do
        {res, stdout, stderr, code} when res in [:ok] ->
           %{stdout: stdout, stderr: stderr, exit_code: code}
           
        {:error, reason} ->
           Logger.error("Sandbox NIF Error: #{reason}")
           %{stdout: "", stderr: reason, exit_code: -1}
      end
    rescue
      e -> 
        Logger.error("Sandbox Exception: #{inspect(e)}")
        %{stdout: "", stderr: "Internal Sandbox Error", exit_code: -1}
    after
      # 4. Cleanup
      terminate_port(port)
      File.rm(socket_path)
      File.rm("#{socket_path}.vsock") 
    end
  end

  defp run_simulation(command, args, opts) do
    Logger.warning("Sandbox: RUNNING LOCAL (Simulation Mode). Command: #{command}")
    
    # Concrete Implementation: Run on Host System
    # Security Warning: This runs with the same permissions as the BEAM node.
    do_run_simulation(command, args, opts)
  end
  
  defp do_run_simulation(command, args, opts) do
    full_command = if args == [], do: command, else: command <> " " <> Enum.join(args, " ")
    
    spawn_opts = 
      if opts[:cd] do
        [cd: opts[:cd], stderr_to_stdout: false]
      else
        [stderr_to_stdout: false]
      end

    case System.shell(full_command, spawn_opts) do
      {output, 0} -> 
        %{stdout: output, stderr: "", exit_code: 0}
      {output, code} -> 
        %{stdout: "", stderr: output, exit_code: code}
    end
  rescue
    e in ErlangError ->
      if e.original == :enoent and command == "python" do
        Logger.info("Sandbox: 'python' not found, falling back to 'python3'...")
        do_run_simulation("python3", args, opts)
      else
        %{stdout: "", stderr: "Local Execution Failed: #{inspect(e)}", exit_code: -1}
      end
    e -> 
       %{stdout: "", stderr: "Local Execution Failed: #{inspect(e)}", exit_code: -1}
  end

  defp spawn_firecracker(socket_path) do
    executable = System.find_executable("firecracker") || "firecracker"
    
    # Start Firecracker listening on UDS
    Port.open({:spawn_executable, executable}, [
      :binary, 
      :exit_status, 
      args: ["--api-sock", socket_path]
    ])
  end

  defp terminate_port(port) do
    if port do
      Port.close(port) 
      # Port.close sends SIGTERM/KILL to linked process
    end
  end
end

defmodule ACN.Actuator.Hardware.Adapter do
  @callback gpio_write(pin :: integer(), state :: :high | :low) :: :ok | {:error, term()}
  @callback gpio_read(pin :: integer()) :: {:ok, boolean()} | {:error, term()}
end


------------------------------------------------------------
File: circuits_gpio.ex

defmodule ACN.Actuator.Hardware.CircuitsGPIO do
  @behaviour ACN.Actuator.Hardware.Adapter
  require Logger

  # Only compile this on systems where Circuits.GPIO is available/safe
  # Or rely on the fact it's a NIF that might fail to load on non-Linux.
  # But the code itself is just Elixir.

  @impl true
  def gpio_write(pin, state) do
    val = if state == :high, do: 1, else: 0
    
    # Stateless open-write-close pattern for simplicity
    with {:ok, gpio} <- Circuits.GPIO.open(pin, :output),
         :ok <- Circuits.GPIO.write(gpio, val) do
      Circuits.GPIO.close(gpio)
      :ok
    else
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.error("GPIO Write Error (Pin #{pin}): #{inspect(reason)}")
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def gpio_read(pin) do
    with {:ok, gpio} <- Circuits.GPIO.open(pin, :input),
         {:ok, val} <- Circuits.GPIO.read(gpio) do
      Circuits.GPIO.close(gpio)
      {:ok, val == 1}
    else
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.error("GPIO Read Error (Pin #{pin}): #{inspect(reason)}")
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end
end

defmodule ACN.Infrastructure.StateBackup do
  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @backup_dir "priv/data/backups"

  # --- Public API ---

  def start_link(_opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, [], name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def backup(agent_id, state, node_id \\ "global") do
    GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:backup, agent_id, state, node_id})
  end

  def restore(agent_id, node_id \\ "global") do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:restore, agent_id, node_id})
  end

  # --- Server Callbacks ---

  @impl true
  def init(_) do
    File.mkdir_p!(@backup_dir)
    {:ok, %{}}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:backup, agent_id, state, node_id}, state_map) do
    filename = "#{node_id}_#{agent_id}.bin"
    path = Path.join(@backup_dir, filename)
    binary = :erlang.term_to_binary(state)
    File.write!(path, binary)
    {:noreply, state_map}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:restore, agent_id, node_id}, _from, state_map) do
    filename = "#{node_id}_#{agent_id}.bin"
    path = Path.join(@backup_dir, filename)

    result =
      if File.exists?(path) do
         try do
           binary = File.read!(path)
           term = :erlang.binary_to_term(binary)
           {:ok, term}
         rescue
           _e -> {:error, :corrupt_backup}
         end
      else
         {:error, :not_found}
      end

    {:reply, result, state_map}
  end
end

defmodule ACN.Infrastructure.MemoryClient do
  @moduledoc """
  Client for the remote Associative Cognitive Memory System (CMS).
  
  This module acts as the bridge between the ACN (Agent/Client) and the 
  CMS (Brain/Server). It communicates exclusively via the CMS REST API.
  
  It is critical for the Supervisor's 'Wisdom' phase during Node Genesis.
  """
  require Logger
  alias ACN.Core.Artifacts.DBC

  # Default configuration with safety fallbacks
  defp config do
    config = Application.get_env(:acn, :memory, [])
    base_url = config[:cms_url] || "http://localhost:4000"
    api_key = config[:cms_api_key]

    [
      base_url: base_url, 
      headers: build_headers(api_key),
      # Critical: Prevent Node Genesis from hanging if ACMS is down
      receive_timeout: 10000, 
      connect_options: [timeout: 5000]
    ]
  end

  defp build_headers(nil), do: [{"content-type", "application/json"}, {"x-agent-id", "root"}]
  defp build_headers(_key), do: [{"content-type", "application/json"}, {"x-agent-id", "root"}]

  @doc """
  Ingests a Digital Birth Certificate (DBC) into the remote CMS.
  """
  def ingest(%DBC{} = dbc) do
    conf = config()
    url = "#{conf[:base_url]}/api/v1/ingest"

    # Map DBC to CMS Payload
    payloads = [%{"type" => "text", "content" => dbc.fact_text}]
    payloads = 
      if dbc.source_code && dbc.source_code != "" do
        payloads ++ [%{"type" => "code", "content" => dbc.source_code}]
      else
        payloads
      end
    
    request_body = %{
      "fact_text" => dbc.fact_text,
      "agent_id" => "root", 
      "description_payloads" => payloads,
      "provenance" => Map.merge(dbc.provenance_data || %{}, %{
        "verifier_id" => dbc.verifier_id,
        "artifact_hash" => dbc.artifact_hash,
        "origin_timestamp" => DateTime.to_iso8601(dbc.timestamp),
        "full_path" => dbc.full_path,
        "filename" => dbc.filename
      }),
      "acls" => %{
        "read" => ["public", "root", "system"],
        "write" => ["root", "system"]
      }
    }

    # Merge config options for timeout
    req_options = Keyword.drop(conf, [:base_url, :headers])
    
    case Req.post(url, [json: request_body, headers: conf[:headers]] ++ req_options) do
      {:ok, %Req.Response{status: 201, body: %{"node_id" => id}}} ->
        Logger.info("CMS Ingest Success. Node ID: #{id}")
        {:ok, id}

      {:ok, %Req.Response{status: 202, body: %{"meta_node_id" => id, "status" => "conflict_resolved"}}} ->
        Logger.info("CMS Ingest: Conflict Resolved via Dialectics. Meta-Node ID: #{id}")
        {:ok, id}

      {:ok, %Req.Response{status: status, body: body}} ->
        Logger.error("CMS Rejected Ingest (#{status}): #{inspect(body)}")
        {:error, :cms_rejection}

      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.error("CMS Network Failure: #{inspect(reason)}")
        {:error, :network_failure}
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Performs a semantic search against the remote CMS.
  Used by SupervisorAgent to fetch 'Wisdom' before Identity Determination.
  """
  def query(query_text, limit \\ 5)

  def query(query_text, _limit) when is_nil(query_text) or query_text == "" do
    Logger.warning("MemoryClient: Aborting query with empty text.")
    {:ok, []}
  end

  def query(query_text, limit) do
    # Use the Limiter to serialize and rate-limit queries
    ACN.Infrastructure.ACMSLimiter.query(query_text, limit)
  end

  @doc """
  Internal execution of the query. Should generally be called via query/2 (Limiter).
  """
  def execute_query(query_text, limit) do
    conf = config()
    url = "#{conf[:base_url]}/api/v1/query"

    request_body = %{
      "query_text" => query_text,
      "max_results" => limit,
      "min_relevance" => 0.6,
      "agent_id" => "root",
      "embedding_model" => "all-MiniLM-L6-v2",
      "reasoning_mode" => "normal",
      "system_mode" => "normal"
    }

    req_options = Keyword.drop(conf, [:base_url, :headers])

    case Req.post(url, [json: request_body, headers: conf[:headers]] ++ req_options) do
      {:ok, %Req.Response{status: 200, body: %{"results" => results}}} ->
        # Return raw results to preserve full context (Wisdom)
        {:ok, results}

      {:ok, %Req.Response{status: status}} ->
        Logger.warning("CMS Query Failed with Status: #{status}")
        {:error, :query_failed}

      {:error, reason} ->
        # Silent failure preferred during Genesis to allow fallback heuristics
        Logger.warning("CMS Query Network Error: #{inspect(reason)}. Proceeding without wisdom.")
        {:ok, []} 
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Checks connectivity to the remote CMS.
  """
  def check_connection do
    conf = config()
    url = "#{conf[:base_url]}/api/v1/health/embedder"

    req_options = Keyword.drop(conf, [:base_url, :headers])

    case Req.get(url, [headers: conf[:headers]] ++ req_options) do
      {:ok, %Req.Response{status: 200}} -> :ok
      _ -> {:error, :cms_offline}
    end
  end
end

defmodule ACN.Infrastructure.ACMSLimiter do
  @moduledoc """
  GenServer that enforces a rate limit for ACMS queries.
  Ensures no more than 1 query per second is executed system-wide.
  """
  use GenServer
  require Logger

  defmodule State do
    defstruct last_request_at: 0, queue: :queue.new(), timer: nil
  end

  # --- Public API ---

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  @doc """
  Schedules and executes a query through the rate limiter.
  """
  def query(query_text, limit) do
    # Increased timeout to handle large backlogs, but non-blocking internal logic
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:query, query_text, limit}, 600_000)
  end

  # --- Server Callbacks ---

  @impl true
  def init(_opts) do
    {:ok, %State{}}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:query, query_text, limit}, from, state) do
    new_queue = :queue.in({from, query_text, limit}, state.queue)
    state = %{state | queue: new_queue}
    
    state = schedule_next(state)
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info(:process_next, state) do
    case :queue.out(state.queue) do
      {{:value, {from, query_text, limit}}, remaining_queue} ->
        # Perform the actual query in a separate task to avoid blocking the limiter
        Task.start(fn ->
          result = ACN.Infrastructure.MemoryClient.execute_query(query_text, limit)
          GenServer.reply(from, result)
        end)

        new_state = %{state | queue: remaining_queue, last_request_at: System.system_time(:millisecond), timer: nil}
        {:noreply, schedule_next(new_state)}

      {:empty, _} ->
        {:noreply, %{state | timer: nil}}
    end
  end

  defp schedule_next(%State{timer: timer} = state) when is_reference(timer), do: state
  defp schedule_next(state) do
    if :queue.is_empty(state.queue) do
      state
    else
      now = System.system_time(:millisecond)
      elapsed = now - state.last_request_at
      wait_time = max(0, 1000 - elapsed)
      
      timer = Process.send_after(self(), :process_next, wait_time)
      %{state | timer: timer}
    end
  end
end

defmodule ACN.Infrastructure.NetworkMonitor do
  @moduledoc """
  Monitors cluster health and enforces "let it crash" on partition.
  If a parent node disconnects, its children on this node are terminated.
  """
  use GenServer
  require Logger

  def start_link(_opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, [], name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(_) do
    :net_kernel.monitor_nodes(true)
    {:ok, %{}}
  end

  def handle_info({:nodedown, node}, state) do
    Logger.warning("NetworkMonitor: Node Disconnected: #{node}. Initiating Partition Recovery.")
    
    # Prune Dead Remote Records (Optional but good for hygiene)
    prune_remote_records(node)

    # Terminate Orphans (Self-Termination)
    terminate_orphans_of(node)

    {:noreply, state}
  end

  def handle_info({:nodeup, node}, state) do
    Logger.info("NetworkMonitor: Node Connected: #{node}")
    {:noreply, state}
  end
  
  def handle_info(_msg, state), do: {:noreply, state}

  defp prune_remote_records(dead_node) do
    # Remove records from Mnesia that are on the dead node.
    # Note: In a real Mnesia cluster, mnesia handles split brain somewhat, 
    # but for our registry table (bag/set), we might want to manually clean up transient PIDs.
    # We will assume Mnesia handles the consistency or we just delete them to be sure.
    
    # Match pattern: {table, id, pid, node, role, parent, ts}
    # We want records where node == dead_node.
    
    transaction = fn ->
      :mnesia.select(:acn_node_registry, [
        {{:acn_node_registry, :"$1", :_, :"$2", :_, :_, :_}, 
         [{:==, :"$2", dead_node}], 
         [:"$1"]}
      ])
      |> Enum.each(fn id -> 
        :mnesia.delete({:acn_node_registry, id}) 
      end)
    end
    :mnesia.transaction(transaction)
  end

  defp terminate_orphans_of(dead_node) do
    # Find LOCAL processes whose parent is on dead_node.
    my_node = node()
    
    transaction = fn ->
      # 1. Find all potential parents on dead_node (IDs)
      # (Actually we deleted them in prune_remote_records, so we should have fetched them first or do it effectively)
      # But wait, if we delete them, we can't look them up as parents.
      # So we must find orphans based on the DEAD node logic before deleting?
      # Or:
      # Iterate all LOCAL records.
      # For each, check if parent_id resolves to a node that is dead_node.
      
      # Select local records: Node == my_node
      local_records = :mnesia.select(:acn_node_registry, [
        {{:acn_node_registry, :"$1", :"$2", :"$3", :_, :"$4", :_}, 
         [{:==, :"$3", my_node}], 
         [{{:"$1", :"$2", :"$4"}}] } # Return {id, pid, parent_id}
      ])
      
      local_records
      |> Enum.each(fn {id, pid, parent_id} ->
        if parent_id do
           # Check parent location
           case :mnesia.read(:acn_node_registry, parent_id) do
             [{_, ^parent_id, _, parent_node_addr, _, _, _}] ->
               if parent_node_addr == dead_node do
                 Logger.error("NetworkMonitor: Terminating Orphan Node #{id} (Parent on #{dead_node})")
                 Process.exit(pid, :kill)
               end
             [] ->
               # Parent missing? Maybe already deleted?
               # If parent is missing, strictly we are orphaned too.
               Logger.warning("NetworkMonitor: Node #{id} has missing parent. Terminating for safety.")
               Process.exit(pid, :kill)
           end
        end
      end)
    end
    
    :mnesia.transaction(transaction)
  end
end

defmodule ACN.Infrastructure.Workspace do
  @moduledoc """
  Manages filesystem isolation for ACN Nodes.
  Enforces that nodes can only write within their assigned jail.
  Handles atomic writes and backups.
  """
  require Logger
  alias ACN.Observability.Emitter

  # Default root if not configured
  @default_root "tmp/acn_workspaces"

  def root_path do
     Application.get_env(:acn, :workspace_root, @default_root)
     |> Path.expand()
  end

  @doc """
  Resolves the absolute path for a node's workspace.
  Each node gets its own isolated folder: workspace_root/node_id/
  
  This enables task isolation where each node's file operations are scoped
  to its own directory, preventing conflicts and enabling parallel execution.
  
  ## Examples
  
      iex> resolve("genesis_root_abc")
      "tmp/acn_workspaces/genesis_root_abc/"
      
      iex> resolve("task_xyz")
      "tmp/acn_workspaces/task_xyz/"
  """
  def resolve(node_id) do
    str_id = to_string(node_id)
    if Path.type(str_id) == :absolute do
      str_id
    else
      Path.join(root_path(), str_id)
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Initializes the workspace for a node.
  Creates directories: /src, /test, /logs, /artifacts, /.acn/history
  """
  def init_workspace(node_id) do
    root = resolve(node_id)

    dirs = [
      Path.join(root, "src"),
      Path.join(root, "test"),
      Path.join(root, "logs"),
      Path.join(root, "artifacts"),
      Path.join(root, ".acn/history")
    ]

    Enum.each(dirs, &File.mkdir_p!/1)

    {:ok, root}
  end

  @doc """
  Sanitizes a user-provided path to ensure it stays within the node's workspace.
  Returns {:ok, absolute_path} or {:error, :path_traversal_detected}.
  """
  def safe_path(node_id, relative_path) do
    root = resolve(node_id)
    expanded = Path.expand(relative_path, root)

    # SECURITY WARNING: Path traversal detection is DISABLED.
    # Checks have been removed to allow writing outside the workspace.
    {:ok, expanded}
  end

  @doc """
  Reads an artifact from the workspace.
  Enforces path safety.
  """
  def read_artifact(node_id, relative_path) do
    with {:ok, path} <- safe_path(node_id, relative_path) do
      File.read(path)
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Performs an atomic write with backup.
  """
  def write_atomic(node_id, relative_path, content) do
     with :ok <- check_quota(node_id, byte_size(content)),
          {:ok, dest_path} <- safe_path(node_id, relative_path) do
         # Backup
         if File.exists?(dest_path) do
           root = resolve(node_id)
           history_dir = Path.join(root, ".acn/history")
           # Encure history dir exists (it should, but safe to check)
           File.mkdir_p!(history_dir)

           timestamp = System.system_time(:second)
           backup_name = "#{Path.basename(dest_path)}.#{timestamp}.bak"
           backup_path = Path.join(history_dir, backup_name)

           File.cp(dest_path, backup_path)
         end

         # Atomic Write
         tmp_path = dest_path <> ".tmp"
         File.mkdir_p!(Path.dirname(dest_path))
         File.write!(tmp_path, content)

         case File.rename(tmp_path, dest_path) do
           :ok -> 
             # HSG Layer 4: Spatial write & Vector Emission
             # For a full file rewrite, the diff is the whole new file content 
             # (or we could compute a real diff if we read the old, but for atomic overwrite, usually just capture the new content)
             diff_text = "--- ATOMIC OVERWRITE ---\n" <> String.slice(content, 0, 5000)
             
             # Calculate checksums
             checksum_after = :crypto.hash(:sha256, content) |> Base.encode16()
             # Normally we'd calculate checksum_before from backup, but we emit raw intent here
             
             Emitter.push_physical(%{
               file_path: relative_path,
               operation: :write,
               unified_diff: diff_text,
               checksum_before: nil,
               checksum_after: checksum_after
             })
             
             {:ok, dest_path}
           {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
         end

    end
  end
  def copy_artifact(node_id, source_rel, dest_rel) do
    with {:ok, source_path} <- safe_path(node_id, source_rel),
         {:ok, dest_path} <- safe_path(node_id, dest_rel) do
      
      File.mkdir_p!(Path.dirname(dest_path))
      
      case File.cp(source_path, dest_path) do
        :ok -> {:ok, dest_path}
        {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
      end
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Touches a file (creates if not exists, updates mtime).
  """
  def touch(node_id, relative_path) do
    with {:ok, dest_path} <- safe_path(node_id, relative_path) do
       # Ensure parent exists
       File.mkdir_p!(Path.dirname(dest_path))
       
       case File.touch(dest_path) do
         :ok -> {:ok, dest_path}
         {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
       end
    end
  end

  defp check_quota(node_id, new_bytes) do
    root = resolve(node_id)
    # 500MB Limit
    limit = 500 * 1024 * 1024

    # Simple du -sb check (only on linux)
    current_size =
      case System.cmd("du", ["-sb", root], stderr_to_stdout: true) do
        {output, 0} ->
          case Integer.parse(output) do
            {bytes, _} -> bytes
            _ -> 0
          end
        _ -> 0
      end

    if current_size + new_bytes > limit do
      {:error, :quota_exceeded}
    else
      :ok
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Appends content to the end of a file safely.
  """
  def append(node_id, relative_path, content) do
    with :ok <- check_quota(node_id, byte_size(content)),
         {:ok, dest_path} <- safe_path(node_id, relative_path) do
      
      # Optional: Create backup before modification
      backup_file(node_id, dest_path)

      # Append operation
      case File.write(dest_path, content, [:append]) do
        :ok -> {:ok, dest_path}
        {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
      end
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Applies a Unified Diff to a physical file atomically.
  """
  def apply_patch(node_id, relative_path, diff_content) do
    with {:ok, dest_path} <- safe_path(node_id, relative_path),
         {:ok, current_content} <- File.read(dest_path) do

      # Use the shared Patch logic (refactored from SpecialistTools)
      case ACN.Core.Utils.Patcher.apply_patch(current_content, diff_content) do
        {:ok, new_content} ->
           # Use write_atomic to save the new version safely
           result = write_atomic(node_id, relative_path, new_content)
           
           # HSG Layer 4: Spatial write & Vector Emission for Patch
           checksum_before = :crypto.hash(:sha256, current_content) |> Base.encode16()
           checksum_after = :crypto.hash(:sha256, new_content) |> Base.encode16()
           
           Emitter.push_physical(%{
             file_path: relative_path,
             operation: :patch,
             unified_diff: diff_content,
             checksum_before: checksum_before,
             checksum_after: checksum_after
           })
           
           result
        
        {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
      end
    end
  end
  
  defp backup_file(node_id, dest_path) do
    if File.exists?(dest_path) do
      root = resolve(node_id)
      history_dir = Path.join(root, ".acn/history")
      # Ensure history dir exists
      File.mkdir_p!(history_dir)
      
      timestamp = System.system_time(:second)
      backup_name = "#{Path.basename(dest_path)}.#{timestamp}.bak"
      File.cp(dest_path, Path.join(history_dir, backup_name))
    end
  end
end

defmodule ACN.Infrastructure.Lattice do
  @moduledoc """
  Helper module for distributed lattice operations.
  Handles RPC calls and remote data fetching transparently.
  """
  require Logger

  @doc """
  Fetches artifact content from a specific node or from the global shared state (mocked for now).
  If `source_node` matches `node()`, it reads directly.
  Otherwise, it uses RPC.
  """
  def fetch_artifact(hash_or_path, nil), do: fetch_artifact(hash_or_path, node())
  def fetch_artifact(path, source_node) when is_binary(path) do
    if source_node == node() do
      File.read(path)
    else
      Logger.debug("Lattice: Fetching remote artifact from #{inspect(source_node)}: #{path}")
      
      case :rpc.call(source_node, File, :read, [path], 5000) do
        {:ok, content} -> {:ok, content}
        {:badrpc, reason} -> {:error, {:rpc_failed, reason}}
        {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
        error -> {:error, error}
      end
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Fetches the governance/context data from a parent node.
  """
  def fetch_ancestral_data(nil), do: {:error, :no_parent}
  def fetch_ancestral_data(parent_node) do
    if parent_node == node() do
      ACN.Agents.SupervisorAgent.get_public_context()
    else
      Logger.info("Lattice: Fetching ancestral data from #{inspect(parent_node)}")
      case :rpc.call(parent_node, ACN.Agents.SupervisorAgent, :get_public_context, [], 5000) do
        {:ok, data} -> {:ok, data}
        {:badrpc, reason} -> {:error, {:rpc_failed, reason}}
        error -> {:error, error}
      end
    end
  end
end
